关键词: Results of Operations and Financial Condition
主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) reported its financial results for the three months ended December 31, 2012. The company announced that net earnings decreased by 15% to $4,566,000 compared to $5,363,000 for the same period in 2011. Diluted net earnings per share also declined by 18% to $0.37, down from $0.45 in the prior-year period. Despite the decline in net earnings, revenue increased by 4% to $17,889,000, compared to $17,140,000 in the same period of 2011. The report was filed as a Form 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on January 30, 2013.
